name: Alphalogic Industries Ltd.
summary: Alphalogic Industries Ltd. specializes in the fabrication of industrial racking and the provision of tailored storage solutions. The company engineers and supplies bespoke storage arrangements, catering to a diverse clientele spanning sectors such as automotive, libraries, food processing, logistics, engineering, pharmaceutical, academic institutions, and information technology firms. Established on September 22, 2020, this enterprise operates out of Pune, India.
